Configure a Time Off Type

User manual · English · 11 steps
Learn how to set up a type of leave: name it, decide who must approve requests, say whether it needs an allocation, and choose the unit employees request it in.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Time Off Types

Click Time Off Types.

4. New type

Click New to create a time off type.

5. Type name

Type the name of the leave type, then press Tab.

6. Approval

Click By Employee's Approver.

7. Allocation

Click Yes if employees need an allocation to take this leave.

8. Employee requests

Click Extra Days Requests Allowed if employees may ask for more days.

9. Request unit

Choose the unit employees request this leave in, then press Tab.

10. Save

Click the save icon to keep the leave type.

11. Type saved

The time off type is saved. Click its name to finish.
